text:
katie: Quick question — which Console role lets an external auditor view redacted application logs? Need least-privilege access, they should not see PII or raw BQ exports.

raj: They definitely shouldn't get Owner. For Console log viewing the key permission is `logging.logEntries.list` (logging.viewer). But we often need a tiny bit more (e.g., resourcemanager read) so the Console can render resource names.

emily: We have a `project/log-reader` group for internal ops but that leaks more metadata than I'd like. Agree that a custom role that only grants `logging.logEntries.list` plus optional `resourcemanager.projects.get` is the way to go.

mike: Fyi our BigQuery exports contain unredacted logs. Important: do NOT grant BigQuery dataset access to the auditor group. Keep Console view separate from BQ.

security-bot: :warning: Policy check: access to PII requires an approved data-access request and timeboxed access (we enforce JIT for external auditors). Please file ticket.

priya: Proposed minimal custom role snippet to add to the project:```json
{
  "roleId": "redwood_redactedLogViewer",
  "role": {
    "title": "Redwood Redacted Log Viewer",
    "description": "View redacted logs in Console without BigQuery access",
    "includedPermissions": [
      "logging.logEntries.list",
      "resourcemanager.projects.get"
    ]
  }
}
``` Then bind it to `group:external-auditors@redwood.com` with an expiry.

raj: Two operational notes: 1) Console will only hide fields if logs were redacted at ingestion or lazily redacted by the log router. If upstream services are not redacting, Console will show raw data. 2) Make sure any log export sinks have `exclude` or separate filtered sinks for PII.

katie: Who do I ping to create the role and set the expiry? Is this infra self-serve or do I open a security ticket?

emily: Open a security ticket with auditor identity, justification, and expiry window. We will create the role and do a time-limited IAM binding (JIT). Include whether they need console-only or also API access. cc @mike for BQ gating.

mike: I'll add a deny/bounding rule on the BQ datasets for that group as part of the ticket. We'll also log the change for audit.

katie: Perfect — filing the ticket now and will tag the auditor + include the expiry date. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
